messages:
jordan m: Quick thread we need a lightweight operational flow for SI co-sell leads that originate from cloud marketplaces or hardware partner referrals AND a short annex on joint announcement timing. We're losing alignment between PMM, legal, and the SI. Thoughts?

tess y: Strong yes. Two separate flows: 1) lead intake -> co-sell handoff; 2) announcement plan (if any). Keep the intake flow machine-friendly and the announcement flow calendar-driven.

omar h: For intake: minimal SFDC fields + handshake states. Example fields: 
```
Lead.Source = Marketplace|HW_Partner|Referral
Lead.Partner_ID = <partner-org-id>
Lead.Handshake_State = pending|engaged|declined|timed_out
Lead.SI_Lead = email
Lead.Exclusivity_Window = N_business_days
Opportunity.Partner_Announcement = yes|no|tbd
```

jordan m: Good. For exclusivity: default 7 biz days for SI to confirm engagement unless Deal_Registration grants longer window. If SI engages, AE moves to co-sell mode and we set Handshake_State=engaged.

elaine r: Announcement annex: if Opportunity.Partner_Announcement = yes then timeline must include: product & legal sign-off, joint press assets, and marketplace listing sync. Minimum lead time = 4 weeks for simple joint blog + 8 weeks for press+events.

tess y: Add a checklist for announcement approvals: PMM sign-off, legal sign-off, customer approval (if named), SI asset readiness, and marketplace listing validation. Also a single calendar invite owner to run the announcement play.

jordan m: Edge cases: duplicate leads across SI and direct sales. Rule suggestion: if duplicate found within 30 days, assign to the earliest created lead but tag both to allow outreach; crediting determined at Opportunity close via revops.

omar h: Automation: when Handshake_State moves to engaged, partners-bot should create a channel thread or post summary to #gow-to-market with: partner, opportunity name, AE, SI contact, and announcement flag. Example JSON payload for the bot: 
```
{ "partner": "ACME", "opp": "ACME - Retail POC", "ae": "jordan m", "si": "si@example.com", "announce": "yes" }
```

partners-bot: Created checklist page https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/Partners/SI+Marketplace+Handoff and posted a template calendar invite. :calendar:

elaine r: Legal notes: NDAs and jointly-branded PR need legal team review. For customer-named quotes we need signed release. Add a SFDC field: Announcement_Legal_Cleared = true|false.

tess y: For HW partners, add an inventory check step and Deal_Registration_ID requirement. If inventory < threshold then mark Opportunity.Status = Hardware_Backordered and pause announcement.

revops: From crediting perspective: add a Partner_Credit_Type field (referral|co-sell|reseller) and tie it to auto-forecast tagging. We'll need revops to own the final mapping.

jordan m: Action items: 1) Omar to PR an updated SFDC field spec (due EOD Wed), 2) Elaine to draft announcement approval checklist (first pass Tue), 3) Tess to add HW inventory step + template emails (POC Fri), 4) Revops to propose Partner_Credit mapping (next Wed).

omar h: I'll drop the SFDC spec into this thread and ping @revops.

partners-bot: Added task cards to the Partners board and linked the announcement checklist. :white_check_mark:

jordan m: Thanks all. We'll pilot this flow on the next 3 marketplace referrals before we make it default. If any blockers surface, flag here and we'll re-sync. :rocket:
